server.name: indexer
server.description: APTL Indexer MCP Server - Raw Elasticsearch DSL queries against the Wazuh Indexer and detection rule management via the Wazuh Manager API.

query.description: Run raw Elasticsearch DSL queries against the Wazuh Indexer. Supports any valid ES query DSL. Override the index pattern via params.index. Examples: {"body": {"query": {"bool": {"must": [{"match": {"rule.id": "302010"}}]}}, "size": 5}}

create_rule.description: Write a custom Wazuh rules file through the Manager API. Put the file name in params.filename and the complete rules XML in body as a raw string. The file name must end in .xml and contain only letters, digits, '_', '.' or '-'. The manager loads rules files in name order, so a file that names an earlier file's rule in <if_sid> must sort after it. The upload replaces the whole file and refuses an existing one unless params.overwrite is true. Example: {"params": {"filename": "custom_rules.xml", "overwrite": true}, "body": "<group name=\"custom,\">...</group>"}

restart_manager.description: Restart the Wazuh Manager so freshly-uploaded rules take effect. Returns once the restart command is accepted; the manager will be temporarily unavailable for ~30-90s as daemons cycle. No body required.

get_rule_file.description: Fetch the raw XML content of a Wazuh rule file. The file name must end in .xml and contain only letters, digits, '_', '.' or '-'. Example: {"params": {"filename": "local_rules.xml"}}
